description: Find all nodes with a specific trigger type. Useful for finding all questions, tensions, serendipities, etc. Use unresolvedOnly=true to find open predictions (no validates/invalidates) or unanswered questions (no answers edge).

missingMetadata.description: Only return nodes that do NOT have this metadata field set. Example: "translated" to find untranslated nodes.

trigger.description: Ordinary authored trigger type to search for. Reserved Reader/CMP thinking blocks are visible only in synthetic_reader mode.

unresolvedOnly.description: For predictions: exclude those with validates/invalidates edges. For questions: exclude those with answers edge. (default: false)

name: graph_find_by_trigger
